theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f ⟨hde, hef⟩
  have key : ∀ (x y : Fin 9 → ℤ) (i : Fin 9),
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then y j else x j)
        = digits_to_num x + (y i - x i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
    intro x y i
    rw [show (fun j => if j = i then y j else x j) = fun j => x j + (if j = i then y j - x j else 0) from by
      funext j
      by_cases e : j = i <;> simp [e]]
    simp only [hdigits_to_num, add_mul, ite_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte]
  have A : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 :=
    fun i => key d e i ▸ ((hrelation d e).mp hde).2 i
  have B : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1 :=
    fun i => key e f i ▸ ((hrelation e f).mp hef).2 i
  have C : ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 = digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d := by
    simp only [hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sub_mul]
  have h9 : ∑ i : Fin 9, digits_to_num d = 9 * digits_to_num d := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_ofNat, Int.nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hsum : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d := by
    have h := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) fun i _ => A i
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, C, h9] at h
    refine (dvd_sub h (dvd_mul_right 7 (digits_to_num d))).trans (dvd_of_eq ?_)
    ring
  intro i
  have h1 : 7 ∣ (d i - f i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
    refine (dvd_neg.mpr (dvd_add (dvd_sub (B i) hsum) (A i))).trans (dvd_of_eq ?_)
    ring
  exact IsCoprime.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right (IsCoprime.pow_right (by decide : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) (10 : ℤ))) h1
